subject: general
question:
Identify the below tool used on the Lathe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d2049f1732d6e84a07dface9abaafc9d7f99e89135f827a262a54ad33f1cd76.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __Threading tool.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Threading tool__ is used to create threads on workpieces.
 
• A threading tool is typically designed to form threads of specific sizes and profiles.
 
• These tools are commonly used in lathe machines to cut threads internally or externally.
 
• Threading tools ensure precision and uniformity in the threads produced.
 
• They are essential for creating components that require threaded connections, such as screws, bolts, and nuts.
